svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Omnichannel contact center on Amazon Connect
svg.desc: Omnichannel contact center on Amazon Connect. 14 components in 6 groups. Connections: Voice to Amazon Connect (PSTN); Web chat to Amazon Connect (WebSocket); Web and app to Amazon Connect (WebRTC); Amazon Connect to Amazon Lex (bot); Amazon Connect to AWS Lambda (screen pop); Amazon Connect to Live agents (route); Amazon Connect to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams (stream); Amazon Lex to Amazon Polly; AWS Lambda to Amazon DynamoDB; Live agents to AWS End User Messaging; Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to Amazon Transcribe; Amazon Transcribe to Amazon Comprehend; Amazon Comprehend to Amazon Quick Sight.

text.tspan: OMNICHANNEL CONTACT CENTER ON AMAZON CONNECT
Amazon Connect hands each contact to a self-service bot, a CRM screen pop or a live agent, and streams it to Contact Lens analytics
